collection.name: Minecraft
collection.description: Minecraft game servers, modded runtimes and network proxies
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Purpur
shard.description: Drop-in replacement for Paper servers designed for configurability, new fun gameplay mechanics and high performance.
shard.author: PurpurMC & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Purpur Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Purpur version..."
    MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur | jq -r '.versions[-1]')
fi

echo "Target Minecraft version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"

if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Purpur build for ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}..."
    BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -s https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${MINECRAFT_VERSION} | jq -r '.builds.latest')
fi

echo "Target build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/${BUILD_NUMBER}/download"

echo "Downloading Purpur from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Writing eula.txt..."
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Purpur installation completed successfully!"

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the executable jar file to run Purpur.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version to install, e.g. 1.21.4, 1.20.4 or 'latest'.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: Purpur build number or 'latest' for the newest release.
